name: Archive Vlog
summary: Turn city and travel clips and photos into a 16:9 cinematic vlog: a letterbox opening with a decoding title, an archived-by credit, a montage cut on the beat and a fade to black, as a new editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Uses existing Panel saved-Draft reads and SDK stat/readRange for plugin-private source verification; no SDK/client change is required. Working-copy checks precede one save; independent saved-source verification follows it. Unconfirmed reads retain the saved Draft ID without replay. Installed-app/Windows, playback and export remain unverified. Existing Runtime FFmpeg/FFprobe and FileSystem are required for optional native analysis; no additional tools to install.

inputs.label: Clips and photos
inputs.hint: Choose at least 2 different video clips; photos are optional. Up to 50 files total. City/travel moments work well: streets, crowds, trams, boats, landmarks and food.
inputs.query: city and travel moments: a street, a crowd, a tram, a boat or a landmark

prepare: At least 2 different video clips of city or travel moments; photos are optional. Up to 50 files total.
Videos analyzed, so the scene search can find their shots
